responsibility: This generator initializes the optab layer from machine-description patterns by matching named insns and expands against optabs.def conventions and emitting both a header and source file for optab lookup. It collects matching optab_pattern records, sorts and encodes them, generates pattern-availability tables, raw_optab_handler and swap_optab_enable lookup logic, partial-vector capability tests, overloaded code/gen wrappers, and the generated arrays that map between optabs, RTX codes, libcalls, and instruction codes.
